# Checkbox

`ui.checkbox` · parts: `Checkbox` · elements: `<input>`

## Purpose

Checkbox is a native input[type=checkbox]; pair it with Label.

## Notes

_No additional notes for Checkbox yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<input type="checkbox">` |
| checked | `{"Name":"t","Value":"1","Checked":true,"Required":true}` | `<input type="checkbox" name="t" value="1" checked required>` |
| disabled | `{"Disabled":true,"AriaInvalid":"true","ID":"c1"}` | `<input type="checkbox" id="c1" disabled aria-invalid="true">` |
| Checked | `{"Checked":true}` | `<input type="checkbox" checked>` |
| Required | `{"Required":true}` | `<input type="checkbox" required>` |
| Disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<input type="checkbox" disabled>` |

## Usage

Fixture `checked` (`{"Name":"t","Value":"1","Checked":true,"Required":true}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<input type="checkbox" name="t" value="1" checked required>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "./ui/checkbox/checkbox";

<Checkbox checked required name="t" value="1" />
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Checkbox from "./ui/checkbox/Checkbox.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Checkbox checked required name="t" value="1" />
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Checkbox from "./ui/checkbox/Checkbox.svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox checked={true} required={true} name="t" value="1" />
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "./ui/checkbox/checkbox.solid";

<Checkbox checked required name="t" value="1" />
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderCheckbox } from "./ui/checkbox/checkbox.wc";

document.body.append(renderCheckbox({ checked: true, required: true, name: "t", value: "1" }));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/checkbox"

@checkbox.Checkbox(checkbox.CheckboxProps{Name: "t", Value: "1", Checked: true, Required: true})
```

**Twig** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/twig.md))

```twig
{% include 'checkbox/Checkbox.html.twig' with { name: 't', value: '1', checked: true, required: true } only %}
```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```latte
{include 'checkbox/Checkbox.latte', name: 't', value: '1', checked: true, required: true}
```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))

```jinja
{% with p = {'Name': 't', 'Value': '1', 'Checked': True, 'Required': True} %}{% include 'ui/checkbox/checkbox.html.j2' %}{% endwith %}
```
